calculation.description: Ranks five-day residual dislocations relative to the daily cross-asset median, with larger positive values assigned to laggards and normalized by 20-day realized volatility. Signal uses only information available at the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC and ICIR in 2020-2022, 2023-2024, and 2025-2026; the middle regime ICIR is near the admission boundary, so ongoing revalidation is required. Small 15-instrument cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
